HOW IT WORKS

A clear workflow from start to finish

Document controls keep commercial details editable while supported conversion and duplication actions reuse information that has already been entered.

01

Choose a document

Start an invoice, quote, order, delivery, purchase, or supported custom document.

02

Arrange the details

Add and organize line items, quantities, prices, taxes, discounts, and fees.

03

Add context

Complete dates, notes, terms, status, and other supported fields.

04

Reuse the work

Convert or duplicate supported documents, then review the resulting record.

KEY CAPABILITIES

Everything you need for this workflow

Flexible discounts

Apply supported fixed or percentage adjustments.

Line-item control

Add, edit, remove, and arrange document charges.

Taxes and fees

Calculate supported tax and additional fee information.

Document conversion

Move supported business documents into an invoice draft.

Duplication

Reuse an existing supported document with less repeat entry.

Custom categories

Organize other business documents with configured categories.

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

Questions about document customization

Can discounts be fixed or percentage-based?

The audited feature set includes supported fixed and percentage discount handling.

Which documents can be converted?

Conversion depends on the document type and actions available in the active application.

Can I duplicate a document?

Duplication is supported for relevant document workflows; always review the new record.

Does customization change an issued historical document?

Use the application status and editing safeguards, and preserve finalized records according to your requirements.
